name: Over The Door 19-Hook Hanger
description:
Over The Door 19-Hook Hanger
Product type : Hanger 
Width: 20 inches
Height (including door hooks): 18.5 inches (10" for hooks + 8.5" for the hanging section)
Hanging Section Height: 8.5 inches
Door Hook Height: 10 inches
Designed to hang over the top of a standard door.
Made of durable metal with a sleek black finish.
Features 19 hooks in total, organized in two rows for efficient storage.
Ideal for hanging coats, hats, bags, scarves, towels, and more.
No tools or drilling required—simply place over the door for instant use.

Color: As picture given
